title: Convoy Movement Report
body: COMMAND THIS IS FALCON NEST STOP ENEMY CONVOY OF TWELVE VESSELS SPOTTED MOVING NORTHEAST FROM PORT MERIDIAN AT DAWN STOP ESCORT APPEARS LIMITED TO THREE DESTROYERS AND ONE LIGHT CRUISER STOP RECOMMEND IMMEDIATE AERIAL RECONNAISSANCE BEFORE THE CONVOY REACHES THE NORTHERN NARROWS STOP FUEL RESERVES AT THE HARBOR APPEAR LOW BASED ON REDUCED SMOKE OUTPUT FROM THE REFINERY STACKS STOP AWAITING FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS FROM HIGH COMMAND STOP END TRANSMISSION

title: Scrambled Directive
body: ATTENTION ALL STATIONS THIS DIRECTIVE SUPERSEDES PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS REGARDING THE HANDLING OF CAPTURED DOCUMENTS STOP ALL PAPERS RECOVERED FROM ENEMY POSITIONS ARE TO BE FORWARDED UNREAD AND UNOPENED TO THE INTELLIGENCE SECTION AT DIVISIONAL HEADQUARTERS WITHIN TWELVE HOURS OF CAPTURE STOP UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES ARE MAPS OR CODEBOOKS TO BE RETAINED BY THE CAPTURING UNIT FOR ANY REASON STOP RECEIPTS WILL BE ISSUED FOR EVERY ITEM FORWARDED AND COMMANDERS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR ENSURING NOTHING IS LOST IN TRANSIT STOP ACKNOWLEDGE THIS DIRECTIVE BY RETURN SIGNAL

title: Flash Traffic - Ford Crossing
body: FLASH TRAFFIC STOP BRIDGE AT KESTREL FORD IS MINED STOP DO NOT CROSS BEFORE DAWN STOP AWAIT GREEN FLARE STOP END
